description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Undefined' used within the Smarty templating engine. The class handles calls to undefined methods or obsolete extensions, providing mechanisms for error handling and property decoding.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Undefined
classes.description: Handles calls to undefined methods or extensions, manages error reporting for such cases, and provides property decoding for the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an optional class name for an undefined extension.

methods.name: decodeProperties
methods.description: Handles the decoding of properties, invalidates cached versions if necessary, and forces template recompilation.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method invoked when an undefined method is called; throws an exception indicating the method or extension is undefined.
